title: Receipt OCR Batch Processing System for Automated Order Entry
description: Design and implement a CLI-based system that processes receipt images from a folder, extracts Chinese text data using OCR+LLM, matches products against database using fuzzy matching, and creates orders via existing API

key_areas: Order creation API and data structures
Database schema for orders and products

requirements.processing: OCR + LLM extraction, fuzzy product matching
requirements.validation: User manual review via existing web UI
